scope: Positive control on original harmonics1/Re382 TRAIN trajectory only; no independent validation/generalization claim
comparison: A vs B fixed extrapolation; B vs C added own-state midpoint momentum plus divergence losses; C vs D representation bundle (curl and geometry taper). Same seed/data schedule/trunk/budgets, not identical compute or output-head count.
zero_initialization: A initially linear extrapolation; B/C/D initially persistence; initial CNN/trunk randomization and NumPy sample schedules matched
positive_control_selection: Full238 own-prediction trajectory on same training case. Lexicographic: pass prospective mass-growth gate first, then average Eu/Ep. If none pass mass, preserve lowest-error failing checkpoint. Fine-tuning begins best checkpoint of first phase.
mass_gate: Mean interior predicted divergence RMS <= max(3*initialPrefixRMS,3*referenceMeanRMS,1e-3). Reference used for scoring ONLY. Engineering screen, not exact NS theorem.
curl: Velocity increments from psi_y,-psi_x; continuous autograd for PDE, matching finite-difference stencil for grid and sampled data. psi_scale=mean(trainStd_u,trainStd_v)/(2pi). Pressure learned increment; no hard past-difference addition.
geometry: psi taper (1-exp(-distanceToSolid/0.5))^2 from known fluid mask. Zero inside obstacle, positive crop edges. Masking velocities after curl disturbs divergence at obstacle-adjacent stencils; guarantee limited to eroded fluid interior.
hard_IC: All three primitive fields equal known current field at local t0; initial resampled reference divergence is not magically zeroed
physics: Continuous NS loss on true first training state; C/D additionally midpoint FD momentum and next-state divergence on EVERY own predicted training step. Spatial boundary-crossing stencils excluded; no periodic or wall crop BC.
normalization: Same frozen train-only global normalizer from69training cases; no validation/test statistics. Own FD losses scaled by mean velocity std, characteristic length/time1.
latency: 3x200 warmed complete GPU steps and actual238 trajectory step times. Separate measured cost of step plus FD physics monitor. Initial states/geometry/grid GPU; no rendering.
safety: Nonfinite or abs(signal)>1000 marks failed full trajectory; score penalty1e6; no clipping or reference substitution
preservation: Save best,last and first-phase-best weights,all full238 per-frame assessments,loss terms and actual scheduler resources
smoke: 3sampled+2eight-step updates per arm with active continuous PDE and full238 own trajectory scoring; functionality only
limitations: Passing a known case does not establish unseen-geometry accuracy
Own-state FD midpoint residual is a discretized consistency measure, not an exact PDE solution
Curl increment does not guarantee full momentum, obstacle-boundary consistency, or long-horizon accuracy
